Electrical Safety Inspections & Compliance Testing in Melbourne's West

An electrical safety inspection thoroughly audits a property's switchboard, earthing systems, circuit breakers, power points, and smoke alarms to detect hidden hazards and verify compliance with AS/NZS 3000:2018. In Victoria, residential rental properties are legally required to undergo an electrical safety audit every two years.

1.5 to 2.5 hours on-site testingLearn More →

Safety Switch & RCD Installation in Melbourne's West

Safety switch (RCD/RCBO) installation provides immediate, automatic power disconnection within 300 milliseconds if electrical current leaks to earth. In Victoria, AS/NZS 3000 requires all final sub-circuits to be protected by dedicated RCDs to prevent electric shock and electrical fire.

1 to 2 hours typicalLearn More →

Smart Home Automation & Control Systems in Melbourne's West

Smart home automation connects your lighting, climate, security, and power outlets into an intuitive, centralised ecosystem accessible via smartphone or voice commands. Bara Electrical Servicing installs reliable, hardwired smart switches and controllers (including Clipsal Wiser and Shelly) that work seamlessly with Apple HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa.

1 to 3 days typicalLearn More →

Switchboard Upgrades & Safety Switches in Melbourne's West

A switchboard upgrade involves replacing outdated ceramic wire fuses or obsolete circuit breakers with modern Residual Current Breakers with Overcurrent protection (RCBOs), surge protection, and compliant neutral/earth links under AS/NZS 3000:2018. Upgrades eliminate electrical fire hazards and safeguard household members from fatal electric shocks.

3 to 6 hours on-site installationLearn More →

Professional TV Wall Mounting in Melbourne's West

Professional TV wall mounting secures your flat-screen display to timber studs, steel framing, or brickwork with heavy-duty brackets while concealing all power and HDMI cables inside the wall cavity. Bara Electrical Servicing installs flush-mounted power points and data outlets for a clean, floating cinematic setup.
